cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've boxed my desk things like you. Congratulations on the promotion. You make moving up look wonderfully simple.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm packing because I get the corner office. You still work here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, making room for your success. Such a relief when advancement comes with removal boxes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Leave your things out. I'll ask them to give you my bigger desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How kind. A whole extra drawer to keep applying for the jobs you get.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies desk packing as shared advancement; B2 distinguishes the new office; A3 masks confusion with room-for-success praise; A5 makes B4 desk gift evidence of unequal outcomes.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 corner office prompts A3 spatial praise; B4 bigger desk causes A5 drawer resentment.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers a concrete benefit and permission to unpack, a plausible conciliatory colleague.

heightening.evidence: A5 weaponizes B4 generosity while calling it kind.

specificity.evidence: A1 desk packing/promotion and B2 new office establish the mistaken movement.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 drawer to keep applying is an awkward relation between furniture and action; A3 removal-box praise is also labored.
